intro.text: Quellion's sister, whom Spook describes as wearing a skaa dress with striking elegance.
A half-skaa, half-noble Coinshot from Urteau and the sister of Quellion.

items.text: Beldre was at her brother Quellion's side when Spook caused a scene during one of his speeches.
It was Beldre who used Allomancy to stop Spook from killing a guard with a sword during that scene, though Spook assumed Quellion was the Coinshot.
When Spook tried to kill her brother, Beldre revealed herself as a Coinshot to defend him.
After the Catacendre, Beldre and Spook were in a relationship.

appearance.text: Beldre has deep auburn hair and green eyes. Spook thinks she can wear a plain skaa dress with striking elegance.

personality.text: Beldre dislikes confrontation but will stand up for what she believes is right.
She is naive and trusting, and knows it. Her inexperience showed when she came alone to Spook's hideout.
